page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head and page number at the top. Below the text, a centred title block (heading with title, two lines of the work's title), then the greeting "Viro" set at the right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: subjiciuntur. Quarta actiones, quæ de validitate aut invaliditate Matrimoniorum intenduntur, quarum prima initia emicuerunt ante annos circiter 45. atque à decem annis invaluerunt.

Prodiit Arnaldi liber 15. Episcoporum & Lectissimorum 20 Sorbonæ Docto-rum testimoniis commendatus: insur-gunt tamen Jesuitæ, & in eum publicis prædicationibus ut in Lutheranum, Cal-vinianum, & quid non invehuntur: cum autem ad Pontificem provocandum es-set, qui de Autore & approbatoribus judicium ferret, potestates Mundi advo-cant, ut eorum Autoritate & Liber & Autor & ipse Approbatores, si fieri po-tuisset, opprimantur: Verùm ipsis ac-cidit, quod minatur Euripides in Andro-mache, Θυμώμεθ᾽[?] δὲ τάξεταί Θυμωμένων[?].
main_text.head: EPIST. LXX. J. Henricus Hottingerus Simeoni de Mais. Defensio Veritatis Hebraicæ adversus Johannem Morinum.

page.notes: The Greek line is hard to read; the first and second words are uncertain and marked [?]. A small superscript e stands at the end of the first line ("quæd"), beside the word "quæ de"; it is not clearly a reference mark, so it is not transcribed. The printed "es-set" appears with a long s that reads as f; transcribed as plain s. The title block is set in italic and roman mixed type as printed.
